text_block_list.text:
On the morning of the JBC Classic, on our 
way to the racecourse, at Smart Falcon's 
earnest request—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Feeling a bit chilly lately~? For anyone 
like that, here's what I recommend♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's the JBC Classic☆ Let's get fired up 
with a hot dirt race~♪"
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to working with you~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Come visit me again sometime~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Handing out flyers! Even though Falco was 
the one who said she wanted to do it, 
you're still keeping me company.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I worked so hard to get stronger! I 
wanted to do everything I could so that 
lots of people would see me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright☆ I'll hand them all out before 
time's up~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That being said, we'll probably have a 
little... well, maybe a lot left over, 
though—

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you Smart Falcon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Twin tails are wings to my dreams☆ Cute 
even when front-running! That's me, Falco☆

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! That's the one I saw at the concert! 
You've been working so hard lately! I'm 
rooting for you. Give me a flyer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! Thanks a bunch~☆

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
"Give me one too! Dirt's been super hype 
lately, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby D
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any plans today, so maybe 
I'll go watch.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaa~...! I'm super happy☆ I'll be 
waiting♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby E
text_block_list.text:
Looks pretty lively over there. What's 
this... the "JBC Classic", huh...
And—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...All the flyers were handed out... It 
feels like a dream...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Y-You think so too, right? Falco isn't 
imagining things, right!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Smart Falcon! Good luck in 
today's race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm rootin' for ya~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-Thanks~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, there's so many spectators 
too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That means word's spreading to everyone 
about how exciting dirt racing is, right?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Then in today's race, I can't afford 
to let them down."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hype up the race, and put on the best 
concert! —That's Falco's mission!
